footer.tagline: Pioneering wearable intelligence to help you understand your health trends and biometric recovery.

home.subtitle: Vitamin & Supplement Intelligence powered by AI and wearable biometric data. Stop guessing with generic formulas, start knowing what your body needs.
home.loop1Body: Connect your WHOOP and advanced biometric hand scanners to pull continuous heart rate variability, sleep patterns, and recovery metrics in real time. We analyze your baseline automatically.
home.loop2Body: Our machine learning engine predicts micro-nutrient deficiencies before they become illnesses, analyzing millions of data points to find your exact vitamin needs.
home.loop3Body: Automated is great, but verified is better. Certified clinical professionals verify every AI recommendation before it reaches your dashboard.
home.loop4Body: Receive dynamically adjusting supplement formulations designed exclusively for your biometric profile. As your body changes, so does your formulation, optimizing your long-term health trajectory.

handScanner.guideSubtitle: Our AI analyzes the color and condition of your nails, palm, and skin to identify nutritional patterns.
handScanner.tipLightBody: Stand near a window or go outside. Avoid harsh artificial lights or flash.
handScanner.tipPalmBody: Hold your dominant hand flat with fingers slightly spread, palm up.
handScanner.tipFrameBody: Keep your hand 20–30 cm from the camera so nails and palm are clearly visible.
handScanner.cameraDenied: Camera access denied. Please allow camera access in your browser settings.
handScanner.cameraHint: Place your open hand in the frame · Natural light recommended

handScanner.pendingReviewBody: Your detected nutritional gaps, food and supplement suggestions, and meal plan are reviewed by a pharmacist before they reach your dashboard. You'll see them there once approved.
handScanner.requestReviewSent: Request sent — a pharmacist will prioritize your review.

clientDashboard.subtitle: Your personalized nutrition & health intelligence
clientDashboard.noAnalysisBody: Take your first hand scan in natural light. Our AI will analyze your nail, palm, and skin condition to generate personalized nutrition recommendations.
clientDashboard.pendingReviewBody: Submitted {{time}}. A pharmacist is reviewing your scan; your gaps, food, and supplement suggestions will appear here once approved.
clientDashboard.pendingReviewBodyModified: Your scan is back with the pharmacist for a closer look before it's finalized.
clientDashboard.notInCatalog: Not in your pharmacy's catalog yet
clientDashboard.disclaimerGateBody: Before your supplement suggestions are shown, there's a short note about what this report is — and isn't.
clientDashboard.reportSummary: This report covers {{signals}} things we could see and {{gaps}} nutrients that may be worth attention. Every section below is tagged with how sure we are — tap the "?" on any tag to see why.
clientDashboard.supplementGateNote: These suggestions reached you only after a pharmacist reviewed this report. They are not a prescription — talk to a pharmacist before you start, stop, or change anything.
clientDashboard.catalogMatchCaption: Matched to your catalogue by name — a convenience link, not a clinical endorsement or a fit score.
clientDashboard.talkBeforeStarting: Talk to a pharmacist before starting

wellnessOverview.connectMore: Connect {{source}} to see more of this comparison

disclaimerModal.step1Title: What this report is — and isn't
disclaimerModal.step1Body: This is an AI-generated wellness summary based on your hand scan and connected data. It is not a diagnosis and not a substitute for advice from a doctor or pharmacist.
disclaimerModal.step1Warning: Don't start, stop, or change any medication or treatment based on this report. Confirm anything here with a qualified professional first.
disclaimerModal.step2Body: The supplement suggestions in this report are meant to be reviewed with a pharmacist before you act on them. You can start that now — it takes a minute and there is no obligation.
disclaimerModal.backToReports: I'll review it myself for now

careActions.title: Care Actions
careActions.subtitle: Bring a real person into the loop — a pharmacist for supplement questions, or a licensed provider for a full consult.
careActions.statusPending: You have a request in review — sent {{time}}.
careActions.pharmacistBody: Send your report to a HYG.3 pharmacist. They'll review your supplement suggestions and reply with notes, or set up a short call if needed.
careActions.pharmacistReason: Patient requested a pharmacist review from Care Actions ({{context}}).
careActions.telemedicineBody: For anything beyond supplements, we'll hand you to an independent licensed provider for a video consult. The request is logged here first.
careActions.telemedicineReason: Patient requested a telemedicine consult (external provider handoff) from Care Actions ({{context}}).
careActions.requestFailed: Couldn't send that request. Please try again.
careActions.auditNote: Every request here is recorded — what was recommended, who reviewed it, what they decided, and the outcome.

dataSources.title: Connected Data Sources
dataSources.subtitle: Connect a device or lab so HYG.3 can show your trends. Each source has its own consent — connecting one never shares anything from another.
dataSources.consentCheckbox: I consent to HYG.3 accessing this {{name}} data for the purpose above. I can disconnect and withdraw consent at any time.
dataSources.footNote: Disconnecting a source stops new syncs and withdraws consent for that source only. Existing readings can be removed on request.

fact.title: Fact — directly observed
fact.body: Something measured or seen in your data, not interpreted. Reported as-is.

inference.title: Inference — our best reading
inference.body: A pattern we drew from the facts above. It is a likelihood, not a confirmed finding, and it can be wrong.

recommendation.title: Recommendation — a suggestion to discuss
recommendation.body: A suggested next step based on the inference. It is not a prescription. A pharmacist reviews supplement suggestions before you act on them.

uncertain.title: Uncertain — treat with caution
uncertain.body: Where the data is thin or mixed. Confirm anything here with a professional before changing what you do.
